maxItems.title: Maximum companies
maxItems.description: Maximum number of companies to probe from input.

requestDelayMs.title: Request delay
requestDelayMs.description: Delay between company probes in milliseconds.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for each page request.

maxCareersUrls.title: Maximum careers URLs
maxCareersUrls.description: Maximum careers/job candidate URLs to probe per company.

includeGenericCareers.title: Include generic careers pages
includeGenericCareers.description: Emit a generic board detection when no supported ATS provider is found but a careers page exists.

emitMissesToDataset.title: Emit misses to dataset
emitMissesToDataset.description: When true, no-board records are pushed to the dataset with record_type=miss. By default misses are written only to key-value storage.
